title: Can I BEAT Villagers Chess?
summary: chess.com variant Villagers Chess (by Baqueano) in 1-minute games vs humans (~1500): the king is a royal pawn, the queen is gone, eight Soldiers (fW) on the 2nd rank and two Sergeants (fW+fF) on the back rank; the royal pawns are offset so each rook faces the enemy royal pawn. Four wins.
rules: King replaced by a royal pawn that moves/captures like a pawn (transcript 0:01, 2:00).
Soldier (round head): moves and captures one square straight ahead (0:07, 5:10).
Sergeant (pointed head): moves and captures one square forward or diagonally forward (0:07).
No queen (1:24). Royal pawns not facing each other: rook d1 faces royal pawn d8 (0:24).
Checkmate the royal pawn wins; promotion R/B/N(/K) per the variant page.
setup: bsnkrnsb/oooooooo/8/8/8/8/OOOOOOOO/BSNRKNSB (o = soldier, s = sergeant, k = royal pawn); from stills maxres1/maxres2, matches the FEN4 on chess-variants.fandom.com/wiki/Villagers_Chess
evidence: frame line: villager pieces, partial white back rank, Delhy 1514, me 1780. | cm-recheck2 2026-11-25: transcript (analyze_video) 0:01 royal pawn + soldier/sergeant definitions, 0:24 offset royals, 1:24 no queen, 12:00/17:07 wins; stills maxres1/2 read square by square; variant FEN4 from the fandom wiki.
